okla.about: Okla Electric is a Pakistani EV manufacturer building affordable, eco-friendly electric bikes and scooters for everyday city commuting. In partnership with Ravi Sundar, Okla set up the brand's first assembly facility outside China, right here in Pakistan.

metro.about: Metro traces back to the Yunas Group of Industries, which began in 1973 manufacturing household fans under the Metro name. The company later expanded into home appliances and motorcycles, and now also offers electric scooters through its Metro E-Vehicles lineup.

united.about: United Auto Industries is a Pakistani manufacturer based in Lahore, founded in 1999 by Sana Ullah Chaudhary. Known for durable, economical motorcycles and rickshaws, United is Pakistan's second-largest motorcycle brand after Atlas Honda, and now also produces electric bike models.

crown-cmc.about: Crown Group is a prominent motorcycle solutions group in Pakistan, having grown over the years into one of the country's leading suppliers of motorcycle and rickshaw parts, engine oils, and electric vehicles.

road-king.about: Road Prince (marketed here as Road king) is a well-known Pakistani motorcycle brand that originated in 2004, recognized for quality motorcycles, autos, and heavy loaders across a range of engine capacities.

hi-speed.about: Hi-Speed motorcycles are produced by Razi Motor Industries, which began in 2004 and expanded across the Lahore region by 2014. Its factory is based in Hyderabad, and the brand's bikes have also been exported to Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.

yadea.about: Yadea is one of the world's largest electric two-wheeler manufacturers, known globally for its wide range of e-scooters and e-bikes focused on efficient, everyday urban mobility.

luyuan.about: Luyuan is a well-known Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer specializing in electric scooters, motorcycles, and other sustainable mobility solutions. The brand focuses on practical design, reliable performance, energy efficiency, and innovative electric technology, making its vehicles suitable for modern urban transportation.

horwin.about: Horwin is an electric two-wheeler brand known for its lineup of electric scooters and motorcycles aimed at urban commuters.

jinpeng.about: Jinpeng is a Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer focused on providing efficient, practical, and reliable electric mobility solutions. The brand offers a range of electric vehicles designed for everyday transportation, combining modern technology, comfortable design, energy efficiency, and dependable performance for urban and daily travel.

evee.about: Evee is a Pakistani electric mobility brand focused on making everyday transportation cleaner, smarter, and more affordable. The brand offers modern electric scooters designed for urban commuting, combining practical performance, stylish design, energy efficiency, and convenient electric mobility for everyday riders.

revoo.about: Revoo is an electric mobility brand focused on delivering practical, efficient, and modern solutions for everyday transportation. The brand combines contemporary design, reliable performance, and energy-efficient electric technology to provide convenient and sustainable mobility for urban riders.

orevo.about: Orevo is an electric mobility brand focused on providing modern, efficient, and practical solutions for everyday transportation. The brand emphasizes smart electric technology, contemporary design, reliable performance, and energy efficiency to support convenient and sustainable urban mobility.

jolta.about: Jolta Electric is a Pakistani electric bike brand with dealer presence across major cities including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, and Bahawalpur.

evinn.about: EVINN is an electric mobility platform focused on making sustainable transportation accessible, convenient, and reliable. The platform brings electric bikes, scooters, and mobility solutions together in one place, helping customers explore modern electric vehicles and make informed choices for their everyday journeys.

velectra.about: Velectra is an electric mobility brand focused on delivering practical, efficient, and modern electric transportation solutions. The brand combines contemporary styling, energy-efficient technology, and dependable performance to provide convenient and sustainable mobility for everyday urban travel.

ecruze.about: ECruze is an electric mobility brand focused on providing modern, efficient, and practical transportation solutions for everyday riders. The brand combines smart electric technology, contemporary design, reliable performance, and energy efficiency to support comfortable and sustainable urban mobility.

eveon.about: Eveon is an electric mobility brand focused on delivering smart, efficient, and practical solutions for modern transportation. The brand combines contemporary design, energy-efficient electric technology, and reliable performance to provide comfortable and sustainable mobility for everyday urban journeys.
